source_title: American Time Use Survey 2025 annual results
unit_or_scope: U.S. civilian population with demographic and work-status breakdowns
direct_observation: The annual tables measure work, household activity, care for household and nonhousehold members, civic/religious activity and socializing by demographic groups
open_conversion: reported time allocation -> constrained alternative -> work/care/community participation -> continuity or withdrawal
evidence_status: official survey tables; no same-person causal chain
next_test: Use ATUS with a longitudinal or administrative source that identifies a later work, care or participation outcome

source_title: Federal Reserve SHED 2025 income and expenses
unit_or_scope: U.S. adults and families surveyed October 2025
direct_observation: The report distinguishes annual income from month-to-month variability; 30% reported income varying at least occasionally and 11% struggled to pay bills because income varied
open_conversion: income timing/price pressure -> liquidity and time trade-off -> care, work or social adaptation -> later room
evidence_status: official nationally representative survey; self-reported and not a linked behavioral episode
next_test: Cross-tab income variability, care work, schedule control and later credit/health/participation outcomes

direct_observation: 73% reported doing okay or living comfortably, while lower-income, younger and Black adults reported meaningful declines; price increases were the most common concern
open_conversion: headline financial status -> usable cash/credit/alternative -> protected or sacrificed consumption/care -> later security
evidence_status: official survey; status and concern are not observed welfare or choice
next_test: Use downloadable SHED data to compare emergency capacity, spending changes, care, debt and later financial room

unit_or_scope: SNAP applicants and recipients under federal program rules
direct_observation: The official route states that applicants should receive benefits or a notice of ineligibility within 30 days after application
open_conversion: rule/notice deadline -> application/contact -> approval/denial/appeal -> benefit receipt and adequacy
evidence_status: official rights guidance; no case-level processing or household outcome
next_test: Pair agency processing/appeal records with a named case or panel that observes notice, receipt, adequacy and correction

source_title: Gallup/Be The People American Identity Survey
unit_or_scope: More than 8,000 U.S. adults surveyed April-June 2026
direct_observation: Community connection is associated with stronger reported agency and belonging; time, work, not being asked and not knowing how to participate are reported barriers
open_conversion: local offer/invitation -> practical participation -> agency/belonging -> durable civic action or trust
evidence_status: nationally representative survey; association, not causal proof
next_test: Find a place-based participation or invitation intervention with later observed participation and institutional response

unit_or_scope: More than 3,000 U.S. adults surveyed May 2026
direct_observation: 76% identified at least one value they believed most Americans share and 79% said respecting different values matters more than sharing the same values
open_conversion: declared shared value -> institutional/cultural interpretation -> participation/refusal -> durable legitimacy
evidence_status: national survey of reported perception; not observed behavior or institutional change
next_test: Compare value claims with a named local, cultural or political decision and subsequent participation or acceptance

unit_or_scope: Nationally representative U.S. adults with engagement clusters
direct_observation: The study classifies distinct combinations of news, politics, civic/community involvement and religious participation, while noting survey undercoverage risks for less-public participants
open_conversion: reported engagement pattern -> information/identity route -> action or institutional voice -> persistence
evidence_status: survey clusters; participation reports are not institutional influence
next_test: Test whether engagement clusters predict a later observed civic action, local voice or institutional response
